changes: Implemented evidence-activated advisory playbook promotion. playbook_auto_promotion_apply now activates only evidence-qualified candidates, writes append-only activation audit rows, keeps learning non-authoritative/gateEvidence=false, excludes DONE-settlement evidence, dedupes outcome idempotency keys, includes activation artifacts in source-lineage audit, updates CLI docs/help/policies, and wires the evidence activation smoke into routine test surfaces.
usage: Use lattice playbook_promotion_status --json to inspect readiness, then lattice playbook_auto_promotion_apply --dryRun --json to inspect eligibility, and lattice playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json to activate only qualifying advisory candidates. Use lattice source_lineage_audit --domain=learning --json and the evidence activation smoke for audit coverage.
expectedOutcome: The CLI exposes a real evidence-activated advisory apply path instead of a default-off placeholder. Qualified candidates can become active only with current digest, applied recommend_activate decision, explicit non-DONE exposure/outcome evidence, clean lineage, reviewed policy, and audit provenance.
actualTranscript: Real-machine transcript passed: playbook-evidence-activation-smoke reported 14/14 checks; playbook_promotion_status showed activationImplemented=true, posture=evidence-activated/apply-eligible-candidates, authority=non_authoritative, gateEvidence=false; playbook_auto_promotion_apply --help showed --apply activates only evidence-qualified advisory candidates and writes audit rows. Full lattice validate passed 31 configured commands and 12/12 verification intents.
outcomeDiff: No user-value difference: observed output matches expected behavior. DONE-settlement rows and duplicate idempotency keys do not inflate activation evidence; candidates remain inert unless evidence-qualified activation succeeds.
limitations: This story implements advisory playbook activation only. It does not make learning evidence authoritative, does not satisfy DONE/Authority/receipt/release gates, and does not add timer-driven background activation.
pitfalls: The work exposed several real closure issues: stale docs suggesting default-off future activation, DONE-settlement helped rows counting as activation evidence, duplicate outcome idempotency keys inflating samples, review-pass staleness after main merge, and repeated stale verification evidence. Future stories should merge main before final review/quorum when possible and remember that delivery-check must be signed by lattice-review-delivery, not the main agent.
